verdict.rationale: Teller documents structured API resources for balances, transactions, identity and account details, with paginated transaction lists. Transactions also carry a documented category field, which is real enrichment an automated workflow can reason over. However, probes found no OpenAPI or Swagger spec and no llms.txt, so the schemas exist only as human-readable docs, not machine-readable contracts. Missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI schema, explicit evidence of JSON response shapes and field typing, enrichment beyond categorization (e.g. merchant normalization), independent hands-on corroboration of data cleanliness.
